children: Eurozone government bond yields open sharply lower, tracking Treasury yields, after a higher-than-expected U.S. consumer-price inflation print for September prompted a brief but significant global bond selloff on Wednesday which then reversed. "A violent move that all but completely turned around into the close," KBC Bank analysts said in a note. The 10-year German Bund yield slid more than 8 basis points to a two-week low of 3.386%, according to Tradeweb data. The decline comes ahead of government bond auctions in Spain, France and Ireland.
